Scaffold a containerized Cloud Run Job and Cloud Scheduler trigger.

## Usage

```bash
drt deploy cloud-run-job [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--schedule`, `-s` | `TEXT` |  | Required 5-field cron schedule, e.g. "40 3 * * *". |
| `--select` | `TEXT` | `*` | One sync selector passed to drt run. |
| `--extras` | `TEXT` |  | Override the inferred drt-core extras (comma-separated). |
| `--drt-version` | `TEXT` |  | Pin the image to drt-core==VERSION (e.g. 1.2.1) for reproducible builds. Without it the image installs the latest drt-core, like `deploy github-actions`. |
| `--output-dir`, `-o` | `PATH` | `deploy/cloud-run-job` | Directory for Dockerfile, job.yaml, and scheduler.sh. |
| `--dry-run` | `BOOLEAN` |  | Print all scaffold files instead of writing them. |
| `--force` | `BOOLEAN` |  | Overwrite existing scaffold files. |
| `--allow-inline-secrets` | `BOOLEAN` |  | Build the image even though project YAML contains literal credentials (they would be baked into an image layer). Prefer *_env references. |
